editorial:
Fracture is a smart, slow-burn thriller that pits two sharp minds against each other. Anthony Hopkins plays Ted Crawford, a wealthy engineer who calmly shoots his wife after learning she is having an affair. Ryan Gosling plays Willy Beachum, a hotshot district attorney who thinks the case is an easy win on his way to a fancy new job. What starts as a simple trial turns into a tense game of cat and mouse, with surprises waiting around every corner for both men.

The real fun here is watching Hopkins and Gosling go head to head. Hopkins is cool and creepy, while Gosling brings energy and charm. The pacing stays steady and keeps you guessing. On the downside, some twists feel a bit too convenient, and the story can drag in the middle. Still, if you love courtroom thrillers and mind games, this one is worth your time. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: Crawford is found not guilty of attempted murder after his confession is thrown out. But his wife later dies, and Beachum refiles murder charges. Beachum discovers Crawford hid the real murder weapon and tricked everyone with a switched gun. In the final scene, Beachum confronts Crawford, who realizes he has finally been outsmarted. Crawford is arrested again, and Beachum walks away knowing justice is served.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves courtroom thrillers and mind games.
